sections.text: P/u 10 3/4" spear BHA from set-back.
RIH w/ 10 3/4" spear BHA on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 25 m. Engaged spear in tie-back casing.
POOH w/ spear and tie-back casing on 5 1/2" DP from 25 m surface.
Installed bushings in rotary. Released spear at surface and r/b same.
Performed TBT for pulling 10 3/4" surface tie-back.
R/u casing tong. Changed to BX-3 elevator. Changed PDM head to handle 10 3/4".
POOH with 10 3/4" tie-back casing. Avg pulling speed 6,5 jnt/hr. Used manual slips and dog collar.
L/d cut casing joint to HTS.
R/d handling equipment.
Performed TBT for releasing tie-back adapter.
M/u torque tool BHA
RIH with 3 singles LH thread 5 1/2" DP
Changed to LH thread saver sub
Performed TBT with ongoing crew
Continued changing to LH thread saver sub, m/u to 95 KNM.
P/u and inspected torque tool. RIH w/ torque tool BHA on 5 1/2" LH thread DP to 139,8 m.
Latched dogs in tie-back adapter. Released tie-back connector by rotating left, 10 KNM.
POOH w/ torque tool BHA on 5 1/2" LH thread DP from 139,8 m surface. Set BHA in slips.
Changed from left threaded saver sub to normal saver sub.
L/d torque tool BHA
P/u and m/u 10 3/4" spear BHA. Inspected tools.
RIH with 10 3/4" spear BHA on 5 1/2" DP to 127m. Engaged spear.
POOH w/ spear BHA and tie-back adatper on 5 1/2" DP from 127 m to surface.
Performed TBT for handling fish at surface
L/o tie-back adapter and remaining casing. R/b spear BHA.
Performed TBT for handling guns
Changed BX elevator inserts and IRN dies. Installed barriers for handling explosives.
P/u and m/u 10 3/4" perforation guns
RIH w/ 10 3/4" guns on 5 1/2" DP to 148 m.

M/u TDS, confirmed line up and filled string. B/o TDS and dropped ball. M/u TDS. Spaced out to 147,5 m. Closed MPR and opened choke. Pressured up string to 140 bar with rig pumps, 150 LPM. Fired guns, pressure dropped to 5 bar, good indications.
Circulated 1000lpm 11 bar, took returns through choke and poor boy. Observed MAX 1 ppm h2s in gas trap, no gas.
Flowchecked well for 5 min over choke, static. Flowchecked well for 10 min on TT, static.
POOH w/ 10 3/4" guns on 5 1/2" DP from 147,5 m to 17 m.
P/u and inspected guns, all shots fired. Meanwhile performed TBT for handling guns.
L/d perforation guns.
Cleaned and cleared drill floor
P/u 10 3/4" cutter BHA. Inspected tools.
RIH w/ 10 3/4" cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 7 m to 319 m depth) 317 m depth).
M/u TDS and filled pipe. Recorded parameters 200 LPM 8 bar, 300 LPM 21 bar, 400 LPM 38 bar, 500 LPM 72 bar, 600 LPM 102 bar. Up/down weight 79/75 ton. 80 RPM 2 to 6 KNM.

Attempted to cut 10 3/4" casing at 317 m, 500 LPM 64 bar, 80 RPM 4 to 11 KNM. Knock in string observed and torque decreased. No pressure drop observed. Pulled up 1 m above cut, no change in SPP observed. Ran in 0,5m below cut, no change in SPP observed and no tag of cut.
